{{Quote|Rattatak is a world of warriors and soldiers. For eons, we have battled one another for the right to rule. We knew nothing of the outside galaxy or your Republic, but still found new and inventive ways to kill one another.|[[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]]|<ref name="HaF" />}}
'''Rattatak''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world unknown to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Geography==
Rattatak was a dry, arid, [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] planet covered in [[Color/Legends|red]] rock, judging by its appearance from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Most [[City/Legends|settlements]] appeared to be hewn into the rock itself. Rattatak's climate was too harsh to sustain widespread agriculture.

==History==
[[File:Rattatak_village.png|thumb|left|200px|A village on Rattatak.]]
Rattatak was one of the unexplored planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Isolated, the Rattataki fought each other as well as at least one other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species in never ending battles. Their way of fighting evolved over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], ranging from melee weapons to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].

The Rattataki tribes united briefly under the warlord [[Rattatak(Warlord)|Rattatak]] who brought the tribes together to push away the animals and creatures that forced the Rattataki to live in caves for safety. Though dying in the process, his efforts allowed the Rattataki to spread across the surface from strong mountain fortresses, contact outsiders and travel offworld, shortly before [[Darth Vich's insurrection]], after which parts of Rattatak were occupied by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire.]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Holonet: Humanoids">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|rattataki|Rattataki}}</ref>

A couple of [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], the Ventresses, massed an army in the southern hemisphere. [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the two; only their foster daughter, the young [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj]], escaped.

Soon, a "[[Ky Narec/Legends|warlock]]" fell from the sky, claiming to be an emissary of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. On sight, they attempted to kill him, but he escaped and found Asajj. Finding that she was strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he began training her as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Together they united armies and brought peace to the planet. Unfortunately, the warlords feared them and united together to kill the pair; they only killed the master. In her rage, Asajj captured and/or killed every warlord responsible for her master's death and established a totalitarian regime over the planet.

Most of the planet was subjugated by the [[Stunger]] state.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Giant_flog.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] fights in Rattatak's [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] pits.]]
It was here that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] first discovered and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|recruited]] Asajj as he watched her [[Mission to Rattatak|emerge victorious]] at the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] death matches of [[The Cauldron]]. He introduced her to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] who gave the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warrior her first assignment, which was to kill [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], only to test the boy on whether he would be the perfect [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Later in the Clone Wars, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was transported to Rattatak by Asajj after her [[Battle of Jabiim|victory]] on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]].

==Inhabitants==
The planetary [[Judicial/Legends|judicial]] system is centered around the gladiator games; those convicted, or even merely believed, to be guilty were summarily thrown into the gladiator pits for the remainder of their lives, short as they might be. The [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] are believed to have descended from an ancient [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] expedition, while the rest of the population are from hundreds of [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] worlds. Mercenaries often come to this world, but are stranded by the planet's failed infrastructure. Most animal species have been hunted into extinction, but a few alpha predators still roam the wastelands.

==Behind the scenes==
Rattatak is misidentified as "Rattaka" in ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.

On the profile page for Rattatak in the Essential Atlas, it is erroneously said to be in the Unknown Regions.
